),
gp_count AS (

)

patterns: room utilization
room booking utilization rate
hotel room utilization
sql:
SELECT
  h.hotel_name,
  rt.canonical_name AS room_type,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN rb.stayed_in_room THEN 1 END)::int AS stayed,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN rb.room_booked THEN 1 END)::int AS booked,
  CASE
    WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN rb.room_booked THEN 1 END) > 0
    THEN ROUND(
      100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN rb.stayed_in_room THEN 1 END)
      / COUNT(CASE WHEN rb.room_booked THEN 1 END), 1
    )
    ELSE 0
  END AS utilization_pct
FROM room_bookings rb
JOIN hotels h ON rb.hotel_id = h.hotel_id
JOIN room_types rt ON rb.room_type_id = rt.room_type_id
GROUP BY h.hotel_name, rt.canonical_name
ORDER BY h.hotel_name, rt.canonical_name
description: Room utilization percentage by hotel and room type

WITH member_event_counts AS (

  JOIN events e ON ea.event_id = e.event_id
  WHERE ea.checked_in = true AND e.zone_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY ea.member_id, e.zone_id
),
returning_members AS (
  SELECT zone_id, COUNT(DISTINCT member_id)::int AS returning_attendees
  FROM member_event_counts
  WHERE events_attended > 1
  GROUP BY zone_id
)
SELECT z.zone_name, rm.returning_attendees
FROM returning_members rm
JOIN zones z ON rm.zone_id = z.zone_id
ORDER BY rm.returning_attendees DESC
LIMIT 200

  COUNT(DISTINCT ea.member_id)::int AS unique_attendees FROM event_attendance ea JOIN events e ON ea.event_id = e.event_id WHERE ea.checked_in = true GROUP BY e.year)
SELECT y.year,

  LAG(y.unique_attendees) OVER (ORDER BY y.year) AS prev_year_attendees,

patterns: Compare reserved inventory to actual bookings by hotel

WITH inventory AS (SELECT
  hotel_id,
  SUM(rooms_reserved)::int AS total_reserved FROM hotel_room_inventory GROUP BY hotel_id),
  bookings AS (SELECT hotel_id,
  COUNT(*)::int AS total_bookings FROM room_bookings WHERE room_booked = true GROUP BY hotel_id)
SELECT h.hotel_name,
  COALESCE(i.total_reserved,
  0) AS rooms_reserved,
  COALESCE(b.total_bookings,
  0) AS actual_bookings,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(i.total_reserved,
  0) > 0 THEN ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(b.total_bookings,
  0) / i.total_reserved,
  2) ELSE 0 END AS booking_to_inventory_pct
FROM hotels h
LEFT JOIN inventory i
  ON h.hotel_id = i.hotel_id
LEFT JOIN bookings b
  ON h.hotel_id = b.hotel_id
WHERE COALESCE(i.total_reserved, 0) > 0
  OR COALESCE(b.total_bookings, 0) > 0
ORDER BY rooms_reserved DESC
LIMIT 200
description: Comparison of reserved room inventory versus actual bookings at each hotel

patterns: year-over-year attendance retention rate
what percentage of attendees return the following year
attendee retention from one year to the next
how many people come back the next year
sql:
WITH yearly_attendees AS (SELECT DISTINCT
  ea.member_id,
  e.year FROM event_attendance ea JOIN events e ON ea.event_id = e.event_id WHERE ea.checked_in = true),
  retention AS (SELECT y1.year AS base_year,
  COUNT(DISTINCT y1.member_id)::int AS attendees,
  COUNT(DISTINCT y2.member_id)::int AS returned_next_year FROM yearly_attendees y1 LEFT JOIN yearly_attendees y2 ON y1.member_id = y2.member_id AND y2.year = y1.year + 1 GROUP BY y1.year)
SELECT base_year,
  attendees,
  returned_next_year,
  ROUND(returned_next_year::numeric / NULLIF(attendees,
  0) * 100,
  1) AS retention_pct
FROM retention
ORDER BY base_year
description: Year-over-year attendance retention showing what percentage of each year's attendees returned the following year
